baseline_contract.confirmatory_comparator_rule: best AUROC among primary, secondary, seasonal_climatology, seasonal_plus_persistence on the same scoreable weeks
baseline_contract.persistence_probability_mapping_for_brie: one-feature logistic calibration fit only on epi_year <= 2023
baseline_contract.seasonal_climatology: logistic regression on first+second annual sin/cos harmonics; expanding labelled history only
baseline_contract.seasonal_plus_persistence: standardized logistic regression on first+second annual harmonics + recent-4-week average + previous-week count + roll4-roll8 trend; expanding labelled history only

endpoint_contract.elevated_definition: sum of confirmed national cases in the next four weeks > 32

evaluation_contract.failure: with a scoreable two-class evaluation, AUROC below the best pre-specified comparator or absolute AUROC < 0.70
evaluation_contract.inconclusive_underpowered: fewer than 10 scoreable weeks or absence of both outcome classes; not evidence of model failure
evaluation_contract.neutral: any result that is neither success nor failure; includes gain < 0.02, binding 4-week paired CI spanning 0, Brier worse than the strongest comparator, or an inconclusive-underpowered readout
evaluation_contract.success: AUROC gain over best pre-specified comparator (persistence or seasonal) >= 0.02; 4-week paired moving-block 95% CI lower bound > 0; Brier <= that comparator; absolute AUROC >= 0.70

calibration.model_probability: raw XGBoost predict_proba; no post-hoc recalibration during the prospective season
calibration.persistence_baseline_probability: one-feature logistic calibration fit only on epi_year <= 2023
calibration.reliability_curve: same 5 equal-width bins used for ECE
calibration.seasonal_probabilities: native logistic-regression predict_proba under expanding-window labelled history

model_contract.fitting_rule: expanding window over every labelled week available before forecast time; no manual tuning between weeks

hyperparameters.scale_pos_weight_rule: n_negative / max(1, n_positive) over currently labelled expanding-window training rows

scientific_boundary: This freeze establishes prospective study anteriority/integrity only. It does not establish forecast validity, clinical utility, causality, treatment efficacy, or public-health effectiveness.
